verdict.rationale: Appwrite is fully open-source and self-hostable, giving users full control over their data and infrastructure (appwrite-docs-14, appwrite-docs-24, appwrite-docs-34), and it documents one-click migrations between Appwrite Cloud and self-hosted, and from other BaaS providers (appwrite-docs-43), implying data portability. The CLI can also pull/manage resources into JSON files (appwrite-docs-12, appwrite-docs-13), which supports data export workflows. However there is no explicit documented 'export all my data' feature or bulk-export tool distinct from the migration/CLI tooling, and no independent verification that a full data export actually works end-to-end. Missing for 10: a dedicated, documented full-data-export feature/guide, and independent/hands-on confirmation that a user can fully export and leave without data loss.
